description: Delete a single Salesforce record by object type and record ID. Works with standard and custom objects.

id.description: The unique identifier of the record to delete. Must be a valid 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID format.
id.title: Id

sobject_name.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (sObject) to delete. Examples: Account, Contact, Opportunity, CustomObject__c. Must be a valid sObject type with proper permissions.
sobject_name.title: Sobject Name

name: delete_sobject

DeleteSobjectResponse.description: Response for DELETE sObject by ID. On success (HTTP 204), no body is returned.
DeleteSobjectResponse.title: DeleteSobjectResponse
